$comment: ADR-352 dung. Every living animal drops Dung a couple of times per in-game day (perDay, per-species overrides for the big grazers/mounts); the drop is a normal LootBag holding 1 dung that despawns after despawnSeconds (10 s) if nobody picks it up. Jitter (±jitterFraction of the interval, seeded per animal per tick) staggers a herd so it never drops in unison. excluded: species that never drop dung on the ground — animal_bee only (it flies; honey is its produce and goes to the Apiary). Everything else that is a living animal entity produces: farm animals, pets, mounts and wild animals (birds included — they land and walk). Dung is crafted into dung_fertilizer (recipes.json), a longer-lasting fertilizer (farming.json dungFertilizerSeconds).
